title: teamLab to Open Digital Art Museum in US
paragraphs: teamLab has come a long way since it was founded in Tokyo in 2001.

Famous for its immersive artworks that explore the meeting points between art, science, technology and nature, its works are exhibited in museums all around the world, and its own museums in places like Tokyo and Kyoto are major tourist attractions.
Now, teamLab is opening its first permanent museum in the US.
The new museum will be part of a new sports and entertainment district called OC Vibe, which is being built in the city of Anaheim, in Orange County, California.

"teamLab Museum Anaheim" is the tentative name for the new facility, which will have a floor space of around 10,000 square meters. A raised walkway will connect the museum directly to the Anaheim Regional Transportation Intermodal Center, which is the train and bus station for the area. And on the other side of the museum, just across the freeway, is Angel Stadium, home of the Major League Baseball team the Los Angeles Angels.

The design for the new museum has been done by architecture firm Smith-Clementi, which also created the plans for the rest of the OC Vibe district. Because teamLab's immersive exhibits require a windowless building, the architects have designed the exterior as a "shimmering cloak" with scales that catch the light and change color at different times of day, according to the OC Vibe website.
Anaheim's teamLab museum will add a major art facility to the OC Vibe district, which will also include parks, offices, restaurants, hotels, apartments and a concert hall.
OC Vibe will begin opening its facilities in 2027, and the teamLab museum is set to open in 2030.
